segments.mil7.6.10:1.1: “Bhante nāgasena,‘ajagarassa ekaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabban’ti yaṃ vadesi, katamaṃ taṃ ekaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabban”ti?
segments.mil7.6.10:1.2: “Yathā, mahārāja, ajagaro mahatimahākāyo bahūpi divase ūnūdaro dīnataro kucchipūraṃ āhāraṃ na labhati, aparipuṇṇo yeva yāvadeva sarīrayāpanamattakena yāpeti, evameva kho, mahārāja, yogino yogāvacarassa bhikkhācariyappasutassa parapiṇḍamupagatassa paradinnappāṭikaṅkhissa sayaṃgāhappaṭiviratassa dullabhaṃ udaraparipūraṃ āhāraṃ, api ca atthavasikena kulaputtena cattāro pañca ālope abhuñjitvā avasesaṃ udakena paripūretabbaṃ.
segments.mil7.6.10:1.4: Idaṃ, mahārāja, ajagarassa ekaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
segments.mil7.6.10:2.1: “‘Allaṃ sukkhaṃ vā bhuñjanto, na bāḷhaṃ suhito siyā;
segments.mil7.6.10:7.3: Ulūko satapatto ca, vagguli ca jalūpikā;
segments.mil7.6.10:7.5: Sappo ajagaro ceva, vaggo tena pavuccatīti.
